span.p:
Bacterascites:
treat if symptomatic,
repeat tap

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Secondary peritonitis?
protein >1, glucose <50,
LDH high, polymicrobial

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
CT abdomen + surgery:
broaden to cover
anaerobes/Enterococcus

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Cefotaxime 2 g IV q8h
or ceftriaxone 1-2 g q24h

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Albumin 1.5 g/kg day 1
then 1 g/kg day 3

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Repeat tap at 48 h:
PMN fall > 25%?

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Finish 5-7 days,
start daily secondary
prophylaxis

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Suspect resistance or
secondary: broaden,
re-image
